jobs.note: [est 15 min] Atlas docs/039 T4 part 2: the same switches on the strip world AtlasStrip_8192.world (needs it installed, see repro atlas-8192-load-strip-8192), sims3-modernization PortalFlagRefs=0 so Atlas owns R7, SceneQuadTree 8192. Pass: armed, the rebuild line (rejected 0, drops unchanged, 11 levels; shapes past 4096 m re-inserted is logged and may be 0 on this empty world), the 0xFEFBCC write, the w8192 install lines, in_world, camera poses over the four lots and two far poses past 4096 m, and a floor pick at window point (640, 360) under a camera at (5920, 5920) that hits floor past 4096 m (agent pick = World.PickFloorAtWindowPoint). NOT covered: a physics range query past 4096 m (no agent command), and a reader-entry counter on 0x681820 / 0x681E00 during the rebuild (not built; G-447 stays inferred unless a fault shows). New: the w8192 patches are released at the gate here, not at DllMain: a missing paint or routing install line is a finding (gate too late for them), not a harness bug.
